title: Another World
identity: Chiel Meijering, Another World (2013), 12:30, Donemus no. 20367, catalogued as soprano saxophone and string orchestra. The composer’s chronological list also has a similarly titled string-orchestra/eagle-recorder version at 12:33; relationship between versions is unresolved.

evidence.claim: Donemus identifies a fully digitized version for soprano saxophone and string orchestra, duration 12:30, with downloadable 34-page score.
Composer’s works listing identifies the saxophone-and-string-orchestra version and links score and recording.
Composer’s more recent work list also identifies the saxophone solo version with string orchestra.
Donemus catalogue record identifies a 2013, 12:30 version titled Another World for soprano saxophone and string orchestra, with a 34-page A3 score. The specific product page could not be opened.

Composer’s current saxophone catalogue does not list this title as a solo-sax work; the composer’s chronological catalogue instead lists “Another world” for string orchestra plus eagle recorder, alto, 12:33, indicating a potentially distinct or revised version.

review_focus: Inference: verify exact solo instrument and edition before judging range, ensemble demands, or college fit. The 34-page score is available for purchase, but was not accessed.
collection_flag: Apparently original soprano saxophone and string-orchestra version, with a title/alternative-instrument ambiguity requiring composer or score confirmation.
